metadata.title: Bridge of Dialogue
metadata.summary: Safeguard a cross-community cultural festival in Kosovo while coordinating Serbian and Kosovar security liaisons, humanitarian relief, and transparent communications.
metadata.content_warning: Fictional depiction of civic unrest, multinational peace support, and humanitarian coordination.

factions.name: Kosovo Civil Security
factions.role: Stabilize the festival, protect civilians, coordinate with NGOs.

factions.name: Kosovo Security Force Liaison
factions.role: Coordinate defensive posture with humanitarian priorities and support local authorities.

factions.name: Serbian State Gendarmerie
factions.role: Ensure community safety, uphold oversight agreements.

factions.name: Serbian Defense Liaison Regiment
factions.role: Coordinate defensive units with humanitarian access and dialogue channels.

factions.name: Local Serb Community Council
factions.role: Organize peaceful participation, counter misinformation, support humanitarian outreach.

factions.name: KFOR Peace Support
factions.role: Maintain neutral oversight, ensure humanitarian corridors remain open.

factions.name: NGO & Media Coalition
factions.role: Deliver aid, document events, promote constructive dialogue.

event_deck.name: Rumor Surge
recommended_responses: Dispatch community liaison to provide verified updates
Coordinate joint statement with NGO observers

event_deck.name: Weather Shift
recommended_responses: Deploy shelter canopies via humanitarian resources

event_deck.name: Fringe Banner Attempt
recommended_responses: Empower volunteer marshals to intervene peacefully
Open dialogue circle highlighting shared festival goals

event_deck.name: Joint Bridge Patrol
recommended_responses: Highlight joint safety briefing to media
Invite community marshals to observe patrol handover

event_deck.name: Dialogue Panel Spotlight
recommended_responses: Share transparent briefing with media coalition

event_deck.name: Logistics Airlift Support
recommended_responses: Coordinate joint press update on aid delivery

unit_groups.description: Coordinates aid distribution and press pool logistics.
